about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/std: edits of the std sources (the .ergo declarations and the Go that reads them) that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/std; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded by ESC1 (wf10, lang audit B F1).

mutants.name: esc1-timeout-nonescaping
mutants.from: f escaping func() A fails E needs R
mutants.to: f func() A fails E needs R
mutants.rule: A joined child task is not the caller's task: a timeout callback cannot borrow a caller-owned Set.

mutants.name: esc1-transform-nonescaping
mutants.rule: types.md, Function values 2: a callback that runs on other tasks at the same time is escaping, so the capture rule refuses a write to the caller's let mut (lang audit B F1, probe race).

mutants.name: esc1-feed-nonescaping
mutants.from: run escaping func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.to: run func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.rule: std.ArgClauses: a Go body's parameter clause matches its review; ActorFeed runs run on a task of its own after feed returned.

mutants.name: c1-capacity-passed
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 2: a cache holds at most Capacity entries.

mutants.name: c1-life-ignored
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 3: no Get returns a value older than the life.

mutants.name: c1-idle-from-born
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 3: the idle time counts from the last read, not the lookup.

mutants.name: c1-evicts-recent
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 2: the entry that leaves is the one read least recently.

mutants.name: c1-waiter-loads-too
mutants.from:
case loading as l:
			(waiting{done: l.done}, u)
mutants.to:
case loading as l:
			(loader[K, V]{id: l.id, done: queue.New[int](0), gone: []leaving[K, V]{}}, u)
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 4: while one Get runs the lookup of a key, the others wait for it. The law OneLookupAtOnce sees it when Go's scheduler overlaps the Gets; the explore leg of examples/lru (ThreeTasksShareOneLookup, dfs) finds it in every run.

mutants.name: c1-replaced-not-released
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 5: an entry a Put replaces leaves, and is released once.

mutants.name: c1-hit-not-counted
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 6: Stats counts each Get answered from an entry as a hit.

mutants.name: c1-capacity-zero-admitted
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cache 1: New refuses a capacity under one.
